findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - A person keeps `/forge` open while runs change and Forge later fails. The recorded live-row walkthrough uses `claude -p /forge`, and this helper starts a fresh headless process for each observation. Those observations exercise text replies, not a mounted pane refreshing in one session. The real-terminal check in `tests/test_mod_install.py:108` exercises an idle pane. A broken live refresh or retained-row display can therefore remain unexercised by the required user-facing walkthrough.
